environment: Windows actual installed Edge, development server
rootCause: Playwright keyboard.insertText uses Chromium native contenteditable DOM insertion. In this workload it expands 100000 native lines before CodeMirror can reconcile them. Real Ctrl+V uses CodeMirror paste handler and a text transaction, keeping viewport virtualization. This distinction invalidates treating the old unfinished insertText command as a measured real clipboard paste.
sourceEvidence: node_modules/@codemirror/view/dist/index.js handlers.beforeinput records insertingText but leaves default native insertion enabled
node_modules/@codemirror/view/dist/index.js handlers.paste calls doPaste and handles the clipboard event
web/main.ts formerly submitted duplicate full-document analysis from both CodeMirror linter and a separate debounce; hover and completion parsed LanguageDocument synchronously
fix: Route large cancellable non-composition insertText beforeinput events through CodeMirror replaceSelection transaction
Deduplicate same-source/profile worker requests, terminate superseded/cancelled synchronous work and expose recoverable analysis state
Keep completion/hover/definition/rename work in a separate cancellable worker
Keep complete diagnostics with paged DOM rendering and a full JSON download
verification: Final controller unit and real Edge browser regressions passed; see features-validation/summary.json, features-validation/browser.json and large-document-timing.json. Complete last-line diagnostics, cancellation/resume and source retention are asserted.
